## Chapter Roadmap {.compact}

:::: {.three-col}
::: {.card .fragment}
<span class="label">Model</span>
Partition the total variation into between-group and within-group pieces.
:::
::: {.card .fragment}
<span class="label">F-Test</span>
Build the ANOVA table and test whether all group means are equal.
:::
::: {.card .fragment}
<span class="label">Comparisons</span>
If the means differ, find which ones with Fisher's LSD and Bonferroni.
:::
::::

<br>

:::: {.three-col}
::: {.stat-card .fragment}
<span class="label">Core skill</span>
Fill in the ANOVA table and compute the $F$ statistic.
:::
::: {.stat-card .fragment}
<span class="label">Core tool</span>
Use `aov()` / `oneway.test()` and `PostHocTest()` for follow-up tests.
:::
::: {.stat-card .fragment}
<span class="label">Core habit</span>
After a significant $F$, run pairwise comparisons to locate the difference.
:::
::::
